request_message: A useful design goal for my project is to keep the system modular, testable, and easy for another developer to understand.

response_body.answer: That is an excellent design goal for your project. Keeping the system modular, testable, and easy to understand will greatly enhance its reliability and maintainability, which aligns well with your focus on graduate-level software engineering. Modular design allows for easier testing and maintenance, while clear structure and documentation make it simpler for other developers to understand and contribute to your project. Let me know if you need help with structuring your code or creating documentation guidelines!
